import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import websockets
import ssl

class ChatApp:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Chat App")

        # 初期設定
        self.name = "名無し"
        self.message_box = tk.Text(self.root, height=5, width=40)
        self.message_box.insert(tk.END, "こんにちは!")
        self.send_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="発言", command=self.send_message)
        self.log_area = tk.Text(self.root, height=10, width=60)

        # WebSocketから受信するイベントを設定
        self.ws_url = None

        # サーバーのURLと名前を尋ねてサーバーに接続する
        self.get_server_info()

    def get_server_info(self):
        server_url_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="サーバーのアドレスを入力してください")
        server_url_label.pack()
        server_url_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        server_url_entry.pack()
        name_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="あなたの名前は?")
        name_label.pack()
        self.name_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.name_entry.pack()

        def get_server_info():
            server_url = server_url_entry.get().replace("https://", "")
            self.ws_url = f"wss://{server_url}"
            self.connect_to_server()

        submit_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="接続", command=get_server_info)
        submit_button.pack()

    def connect_to_server(self):
        try:
            ssl_context = ssl.create_default_context()
            with websockets.connect(self.ws_url, ssl=ssl_context) as ws:
                self.ws = ws
                self.log_area.insert(tk.END, "サーバーに接続しました")
                self.root.after(100, self.check_messages)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("エラー", str(e))

    def check_messages(self):
        if self.ws is not None and self.ws.open:
            try:
                message = self.ws.recv()
                self.log_area.insert(tk.END, f"{message}\n")
                self.root.after(100, self.check_messages)
            except websockets.ConnectionClosed:
                messagebox.showerror("エラー", "サーバーとの接続が切れました")

    def send_message(self):
        if self.ws is not None and self.ws.open:
            message = f"{self.name}> {self.message_box.get('1.0', tk.END)}"
            try:
                self.ws.send(message)
                self.log_area.insert(tk.END, f"送信しました: {message}\n")
                self.message_box.delete('1.0', tk.END)
            except websockets.ConnectionClosed:
                messagebox.showerror("エラー", "サーバーとの接続が切れました")

        self.root.mainloop()

    def __init__(self):
        self.data = [[1 + (y * 4 + x) for x in range(4)] for y in range(4)]
        self.data[3][3] = 0
        self.shuffle_count = 0
        self.image_url = "https://n3s.nadesi.com/image.php?f=16.png"
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(width=360, height=360)

        self.draw_stage()

        self.data = [[1 + (y * 4 + x) for x in range(4)] for y in range(4)]
        self.data[3][3] = 0
        random.shuffle(self.data[0])
        random.shuffle(self.data[1])
        random.shuffle(self.data[2])

    def block_move(self, yx):
        y, x = yx
        ry, rx = -1, -1
        directions = [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]]
        for dy, dx in directions:
            fy, fx = y + dy, x + dx
            if (fy < 0 or fy > 3) or (fx < 0 or fx > 3):
                continue
            v = self.data[fy][fx]
            if v == 0:
                ry, rx = fy, fx
                break
        if rx == -1:
            return False
        tmp = self.data[y][x]
        self.data[y][x] = self.data[ry][rx]
        self.data[ry][rx] = tmp
        return True

    def shuffle(self):
        if self.shuffle_count > 30:
            return False
        on = False
        while not on:
            y, x = random.randint(0, 3), random.randint(0, 3)
            on = self.block_move([y, x])
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.draw_stage()
        self.shuffle_count += 1
        self.canvas.after(100)
        self.shuffle()

                v = self.data[y][x]
                if v == 0:
                    continue
                if v != (y * 4 + x + 1):
                    return False

                self.canvas.create_image(dx, dy, image=image)

        self.shuffle_count = 0
        self.shuffle()

    for i in range(6):

import math
import time
import turtle

# 時計の描画サイズなどを指定
CX = 150  # 中心点のX座標
CY = 150  # 中心点のY座標
余白 = 5  # 左上マージン

# 現在時刻を得る
now = time.localtime()
時 = now.tm_hour % 12
分 = now.tm_min
秒 = now.tm_sec

# 角度計算
時角度 = (時 % 12) / 12 * 360 + (分 / 60) * 30
分角度 = 分 / 60 * 360
秒角度 = 秒 / 60 * 360

# 針を描画
def 角度計算(長さ, 角度):
    RA = math.radians(角度 - 90)
    XX = CX + math.cos(RA) * 長さ
    YY = CY + math.sin(RA) * 長さ
    return XX, YY

# 時計盤描画
def 時計盤描画():
    turtle.clear()
    # 文字盤の背景を描画
    turtle.pensize(2)
    turtle.penup()
    turtle.goto(-CX - 余白, -CY - 余白)
    turtle.pendown()
    turtle.fillcolor("white")
    turtle.begin_fill()
    turtle.circle(CX)
    turtle.end_fill()

    # 時間のメモリ描画
    for 時 in range(12):
        XX, YY = 角度計算(CX, 時 * 30)
        turtle.penup()
        turtle.goto(-CX - 余白 + XX, -CY - 余白 + YY)
        turtle.pendown()
        turtle.color("black")
        turtle.width(1)
        turtle.forward(CX)

    # 内側の小さな円を描画
    turtle.penup()
    turtle.goto(-CX - 余白, -CY - 余白)
    turtle.pendown()
    turtle.fillcolor("white")
    turtle.begin_fill()
    turtle.circle(CX * 0.8)
    turtle.end_fill()

    # 針を描画
    turtle.penup()
    turtle.goto(0, 0)
    turtle.setheading(時角度)
    turtle.pendown()
    turtle.color("black")
    turtle.width(15)
    turtle.forward(CX * 0.5)

    turtle.penup()
    turtle.goto(0, 0)
    turtle.setheading(分角度)
    turtle.pendown()
    turtle.color("blue")
    turtle.width(10)
    turtle.forward(CX * 0.8)

    turtle.penup()
    turtle.goto(0, 0)
    turtle.setheading(秒角度)
    turtle.pendown()
    turtle.color("red")
    turtle.width(4)
    turtle.forward(CX * 0.9)

# 時計描画
def 時計描画():
    時計盤描画()

# メインループ
while True:
    時計描画()
    time.sleep(1)
